pairs: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
“And as for you, son of man:
hæc dicit Dominus Deus terræ Israël:
Thus says the Lord God to the land of Israel:
venit finis super quatuor plagas terræ.
the end is coming, over the four regions of the earth.
Now the end is over you,
et immittam furorem meum in te:
and I will send my fury upon you.
et judicabo te juxta vias tuas,
And I will judge you according to your ways.
et ponam contra te omnes abominationes tuas.
And I will place all your abominations before you.
Et non parcet oculus meus super te,
And my eye will not be lenient over you,
and I will not take pity.
sed vias tuas ponam super te,
Instead, I will set your ways upon you,
et abominationes tuæ in medio tui erunt,
and your abominations will be in your midst.
And you shall know that I am the Lord.”
It has been vigilant against you. Behold,
the day of slaughter is near,
and it is not of the glory of the mountains.
Nunc de propinquo effundam iram meam super te,
Now, very soon, I will pour out my wrath upon you,
et complebo furorem meum in te:
and I will fulfill my fury in you.
et judicabo te juxta vias tuas,
And I will judge you according to your ways,
et imponam tibi omnia scelera tua,
and I will set upon you all your crimes.
And my eye will not be lenient,
Instead, I will place your ways upon you,
et abominationes tuæ in medio tui erunt,
and your abominations will be in your midst.
et scietis quia ego sum Dominus percutiens.
And you shall know that I am the Lord, who is striking.
Iniquity has risen up into a rod of impiety.
There shall be nothing left of them,
and of the sound of them.
et non erit requies in eis.
And there shall be no rest for them.
The time is approaching; the day is very near.
And whoever sells should not mourn.
quia ira super omnem populum ejus.
For wrath is over all of their people.
Quia qui vendit, ad id quod vendidit non revertetur:
For whoever sells will not return to what he has sold,
et adhuc in viventibus vita eorum:
but as yet their life will be among the living.
visio enim ad omnem multitudinem ejus non regredietur,
For the vision concerning their entire multitude will not turn back.
et vir in iniquitate vitæ suæ non confortabitur.
And man will not be strengthened in the iniquity of his life.
et non est qui vadat ad prælium:
And yet there is no one who may go to battle.
ira enim mea super universum populum ejus.
For my wrath is over all their people.
Whoever is in the field will die by the sword.
And whoever is in the city will be devoured by the pestilence
Et salvabuntur qui fugerint ex eis:
And those who flee from among them will be saved.
et erunt in montibus quasi columbæ convallium omnes trepidi,
And they will be among the mountains, like doves in steep valleys, with every one of them trembling,
each one because of his iniquity.
and all knees will flow with water.
And they will wrap themselves with haircloth,
And shame will be upon every face,
et in universis capitibus eorum calvitium.
and baldness will be upon all of their heads.
Their silver will be thrown away,
et aurum eorum in sterquilinium erit:
and their gold will be like a dunghill.
argentum eorum et aurum eorum non valebit liberare eos in die furoris Domini:
Their silver and their gold will have no power to free them in the day of the fury of the Lord.
They will not satisfy their soul,
and their bellies will not be filled,
quia scandalum iniquitatis eorum factum est.
because of the scandal of their iniquity.
Et ornamentum monilium suorum in superbiam posuerunt,
And they have set arrogance as the ornament of their necklaces,
and they have made images of their abominations and graven idols.
propter hoc dedi eis illud in immunditiam.
I have let it be an uncleanness for them.
Et dabo illud in manus alienorum ad diripiendum,
And I will give it into the hands of foreigners as a spoil,
and to the impious of the earth as a prey,
Et avertam faciem meam ab eis,
And I will avert my face from them,
and they will violate my place of mystery.
And untamed persons will enter into it,
quoniam terra plena est judicio sanguinum,
For the land has been filled with the judgment of blood,
and the city is full of iniquity.
And I will lead in the most sinful among the Gentiles,
and they will possess their houses.
And I will cause the arrogance of the powerful to be quieted.
And they will possess their sanctuaries.
And they will seek the vision of the prophet,
and the law will perish from the priest,
and counsel will perish from the elders.
and the prince will be clothed with grief,
and the hands of the people of the earth will be greatly disturbed.
I will act toward them in accord with their own way,
et secundum judicia eorum judicabo eos,
and I will judge them in accord with their own judgments.
And they shall know that I am the Lord.”
